description.value: Prado Coffee is a Vancouver-born specialty coffee roaster that grew from a single bar into a multi-neighbourhood chain, with its Commercial Drive location anchoring the brand on one of the city's most cycling-friendly streets. Founded by Sammy with a stated goal of making great coffee and making people feel welcome, the company now roasts its own beans and ships subscriptions across the region. Cyclists riding the Drive will find a familiar neighbourhood café atmosphere at a location well-placed for an East Side route.
